shots.scriptText: Typing google.com into your browser unleashes an intricate choreography across every layer of the internet.
shots.visualDirection: Visual representation of narration segment: "Typing google.com into your browser unleashes an intricate choreography across every layer of the internet."

blocks.text: Typing google.com into your browser unleashes an intricate choreography across every layer of the internet.

shots.scriptText: First, your operating system checks local caches before querying recursive DNS resolvers to find the IP address.
shots.visualDirection: Visual representation of narration segment: "First, your operating system checks local caches before querying recursive DNS resolvers to find the IP address."

blocks.text: First, your operating system checks local caches before querying recursive DNS resolvers to find the IP address.

shots.scriptText: Next, your browser establishes a TCP handshake and negotiates TLS encryption in less than fifty milliseconds.
shots.visualDirection: Visual representation of narration segment: "Next, your browser establishes a TCP handshake and negotiates TLS encryption in less than fifty milliseconds."

blocks.text: Next, your browser establishes a TCP handshake and negotiates TLS encryption in less than fifty milliseconds.

shots.scriptText: An HTTP request reaches Google's edge reverse proxy, which load balances traffic to backend clusters.
shots.visualDirection: Visual representation of narration segment: "An HTTP request reaches Google's edge reverse proxy, which load balances traffic to backend clusters."

blocks.text: An HTTP request reaches Google's edge reverse proxy, which load balances traffic to backend clusters.

shots.scriptText: The server returns HTML, which the browser engine parses into the DOM tree, computing styles and rendering pixels at sixty frames per second.
shots.visualDirection: Visual representation of narration segment: "The server returns HTML, which the browser engine parses into the DOM tree, computing styles and rendering pixels at sixty frames per second."
